Maybrook Grocers Turns to Electric Delivery Vans
In Castleton, Maybrook Grocers has begun replacing its delivery fleet with electric vans, marking an early step in a broad plan to update how it carries groceries to local homes.
The switch follows a steady rise in fuel prices over the past two years. Although the electric vans carry a higher price up front, owners said the mounting --(135)-- of running older gasoline vans had cut into the store's earnings.
Marcus Follett, who owns the store, has backed the project since last spring. According to a recent interview, once --(136)-- compared the two options, the savings were obvious.
Three electric vans now serve the neighborhood, and drivers have been trained --(137)-- them safely on the town's narrow streets.
The company intends to convert its entire fleet of nine vehicles within the next year. --(138)--. Follett said customers can expect quieter, cleaner deliveries in the months ahead.
